channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Moe Harkless | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Moe Harkless from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Moe Harkless, Rodney McGruder
item.description:
Thibodeau said of the team’s defensive depth.

“You can’t overlook guys like Harkless and McGruder because you can throw those guys in and have them guard a primary scorer for 7-10 minutes. You can give them a lot of different looks. I think the great players in this league, over time, they’ll figure out one defender. “But if you throw different looks at them and put different guys at different times — it’ll also free those guys up offensively. That’s where the great value in having that type of lineup lies.”

Tom Thibodeau on Moe Harkless, Rodney McGruder, Jul 7, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Malone on Al-Farouq Aminu, Moe Harkless
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Mike Malone on @Al-Farouq Aminu & @Moe Harkless defending Jokic & Murray:

“It’s how we space the floor to make (the Blazers) pay for that. If they want to leave it one-on-one, I trust Nikola to score. If they start giving help and we space it correctly, we’ll be able to get great looks.”

Michael Malone on Al-Farouq Aminu, Moe Harkless, May 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Moe Harkless
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Alvin Gentry on return of Mo Harkless for Portland:

“He's a pretty good three-point shooter, good athlete and a good offensive rebounder. He's another (offensive rebounding threat) we have to concentrate on keeping off the boards.”

Alvin Gentry on Moe Harkless, Apr 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @Herring_NBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Al-Farouq Aminu, Damian Lillard, Moe Harkless, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Brad Stevens on #Blazers:

“You start with how special (Lillard & McCollum) are offensively, but Harkless, Aminu & Turner shooting the ball has really helped. They have a lot of guys you can go to, a lot of efficient players at offensive end & versatile players at defensive end.”

Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Al-Farouq Aminu, Damian Lillard, Moe Harkless, CJ McCollum, Mar 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.
